messages:
Alex: quick heads-up — rate card update going out tonight (v2026.04 minor). please read.
Maya: what changed exactly?
Alex: mostly metadata & tagging. new 'special_terms' label so sales can flag discounts/grandfathering/one-offs without waiting for deal desk to parse PDFs.
Julian: great. how do we actually tag a deal?
Alex: add a `ratecard_tag:special_terms=<reason>` in the quote metadata or when creating the commitment in the portal. e.g. `ratecard_tag:special_terms=healthcare-grandfather`
Maya: will that surface automatically to deal desk?
DealDeskBot: New incoming tag processing rule created. Tagged deals will be routed to #deal-desk-queue and create an internal case. :robot_face:
Priya: any impact on quoting UI or just API/metadata?
Alex: initially API + csv import + devx CLI. UI follow-up next week.
Priya: ok want a short note I can paste to AE templates.
Alex: use this: "If your deal requires special pricing/term exceptions, set ratecard_tag:special_terms=<short_reason>. This helps auto-route and speed approvals."
Julian: will this bypass normal thresholds? curious about automated approvals
LegalOps: tagging doesn't bypass approvals. it is a routing and visibility aid only. any approval rules still apply (commit tiers, margins, regional surcharges).
Maya: good. what about grandfathered customers? we have a backlog of POCs with legacy credits
Alex: we'll support a `grandfather` reason value; DealDesk will have a shortcut to mark mapping. ops will publish a mapping table.
Priya: timelines?
Alex: rollout tonight to sandbox, prod tomorrow 0200 UTC. UI + docs next week.
Maya: can we add a small alert in the quoting flow so people don't forget to tag?
Alex: yes — filed FE ticket #PO-472.
Julian: anything for reporting/exports?
Alex: yes, CSV will include `ratecard_tag` column. BI will pick it up.
DealDeskBot: Reminder: For urgent enterprise blockers — still escalate to @LegalOps and @SalesLeads even if tagged.
Maya: thanks. I'll update the POC checklist and ping AEs. :thumbsup:
Alex: thanks all. ping me if you see any strange routing after deploy.
Priya: copying to our channel so CSMs know: https://redwood.example.com/notes/ratecard-tagging
Alex: perf note — tags are capped at 64 chars and must be alphanumeric+hyphen/underscore. use short vocab.
Maya: noted.
Julian: cool, closing the loop on my end.
Alex: closing thread — will post a follow-up doc in #sales-docs after prod verification
